items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: everybody tried to play for that band... Yeah, and I was one of them.

ctx.x: Where would you go to find it? I mean where was the music taking place? Was it jam sessions?

Well, the places down on Central Avenue where Lee -- Lee -- what's Lee's last name? (Inaudible). Lee -- it'll come to me after awhile. When you all are gone, it'll pop into my head like nothing. Anyhow, this fellow, his name was Lee, and he had a band, you know, and he got -- I don't say you know, because you don't know, but everybody played in that -- everybody tried to play for that band. Lee Larkins.
